newsitem.title: UK: Standard extends rebound on press comment.
newsitem.headline: Standard extends rebound on press comment.

text.p: Shares in British-based bank Standard Chartered Plc jumped by more than two percent on Thursday, extending Wednesday's gains, on upbeat press comments on the company's results released on Wednesday, dealers said.
By 0857 GMT, the shares were up 16-1/2p to 800, just 29p off their February 10 record peak.
The shares had come off a bit before the banking group posted its results yesterday.
"People were worried there would be a profit warning," said one market maker. "But the figures were good, they're looking for growth to pick up in the Far East and there was some good press today."
Brokerages SBC Warbury and SocGen issued "buy" recommendations on the shares Wednesday after the results.
